item.description:

  • 日本語名: 紬の花嫁
  • 英語名: Tsumugi no Hanayome

あらすじ

Aoi and Yamabuki are childhood friends. Aoi is the quiet introverted one, while Yamabuki is the loud extroverted one. One night Yamabuki takes Aoi out to a shrine where Aoi gets possessed by a haunted relic spirit that causes the possessed to grow a penis. Together Yamabuki and Aoi go from childhood friends to lovers as they overcome adversity and find true love with one another.

item.title: Jibaku Kanojo ~Kanojo wa Kakurete Mimodaeru~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hending
  • 発売日: 2019-12-20
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (47 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 自爆カノジョ ～彼女は隠れて身悶える～
  • 英語名: Jibaku Kanojo Kanojo wa Kakurete Mimodaeru

あらすじ

“How much do you love me?”

It’s been a week since Kazuya started going out with his first love and classmate Asa. It was the first time he had dated someone, so even such a simple question left him at a loss for words and blushing profusely. She would come up close to him suddenly and stare at him, knowing very well that he would feel embarrassed. He felt like she was doing it just to get a strange reaction out of him, but it was because she thought he was cute when he was flustered. She wanted to see more of it, while he was determined to do the same to her in return.

item.title: Babumi! ~Atashi ga Uminaoshite yan yo!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hending
  • 発売日: 2019-04-26
  • スコア: 7.290000000000001/10 (111 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 刃撫魅！～アタシが産みなおしてやんよ！～
  • 英語名: Babumi! Atashi ga Uminaoshite yan yo!

あらすじ

“Please, won’t you be my momma?”

Living in solitude is quite harsh in today’s society.

Indeed, a mother is required, especially for an adult who works tirelessly every single day.

Enter our protagonist, Tsukishima Jin, one such individual who yearned for a mother to call his own. Having but just met him for the first time, there were four women who complied with his request.
